hook: The $39.99 fix that's not even a shoe rack

scenes.visual_prompt: Shot of a stuffed closet rod, thick plastic hangers crammed together with barely any hanging clothes
scenes.on_screen_text: the space isn't gone, it's wasted
scenes.voiceover: Before you buy a shoe rack, check whether your closet actually lacks room, or the hangers are just wasting it.

scenes.visual_prompt: Side-by-side swap: bulky plastic hangers being removed, slim velvet hangers going in
scenes.voiceover: The Amazon Basics slim velvet hangers are $39.99 for a set, and they're the highest-reviewed product in this whole comparison.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of the same rod now with double the clothes fitting in the same width
scenes.voiceover: 231,174 reviews, 4.8 stars — reviewers consistently say they double the garments that fit on the same rod.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot revealing several inches of freed-up closet floor space now that the rod is compact
scenes.on_screen_text: frees up inches of floor space
scenes.voiceover: That frees up several inches of usable width, which in a small closet is the difference between a shoe rack fitting or not.

scenes.visual_prompt: A small shoe rack now sliding easily into the newly freed closet floor space
scenes.on_screen_text: the 5-minute fix before you buy a rack
scenes.voiceover: It's not a replacement for a shoe rack — it's the five-minute fix that makes room for one.

scenes.visual_prompt: Final text card listing all 5 picks with prices $14 to $180
scenes.voiceover: Full comparison of every pick is on the blog.

caption: The most-reviewed product in my shoe rack comparison isn't a shoe rack at all — it's $39.99 in hangers. Do this before you buy anything else. Full 5-pick breakdown on the blog, link in bio.
